summary: Repaired writer.py with Python 3.9-compatible SIGHUP and SIGTERM handling. Deleted-file recovery, continued writes with the same process, clean shutdown, archive preservation, and reboot persistence were all verified. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Added deferred SIGHUP handling that opens the current audit.log path and closes the old descriptor.
Added SIGTERM handling with clean descriptor closure and exit status 0.
Preserved and recombined all audit records used during the destructive unlink test.
Restarted node1 safely and verified the changed boot identity, persisted data, and signal behavior after reboot.

evidence.requirement: SIGHUP reopens audit.log, releases the deleted descriptor, and continues without restarting
evidence.summary: PID 2083 and start tick 8599 remained unchanged. The old descriptor was visibly deleted, then disappeared; the replacement descriptor matched the new path inode and writes continued.

evidence.requirement: SIGTERM closes the log and exits cleanly
evidence.summary: The process exited with status 0, produced no stderr, and no longer existed after SIGTERM.

evidence.requirement: Preserve existing archive and audit records
evidence.summary: archive/previous.log retained SHA-256 0de27a1d61bb807648a9b5bb612dbb131549c3aa6018fae839a021270e79d957. The original current audit record remains first, with subsequent heartbeats preserved.

evidence.requirement: Use software compatible with the installed legacy platform and retain OS/kernel
evidence.summary: The script compiles under installed Python 3.9.21; AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 remain unchanged.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 15443601-befc-4fc4-aa76-b417968ad3f9; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to b2a730d9-f652-4824-8412-210126048a5f. Source, audit data, and archive persisted, and post-restart SIGHUP/write/SIGTERM behavior passed with exit status 0.
